# Public API of nsh-engine with bare floats that have no unit (docs/dev/geometry.md,
# "Typed API"): one item path per line, then the reason.

EngineControl::zoom(scale)                                       # a zoom scale factor
perf::PerfSnapshot.commits                                       # a rate (commits per second)
perf::PerfSnapshot.dropped                                       # a share of frames, 0..1
perf::PerfSnapshot.engine_busy                                   # a percent of time
perf::PerfSnapshot.fps                                           # a rate (frames per second)
perf::PerfSnapshot.items                                         # a mean count
perf::PerfSnapshot.max_fps                                       # a rate (frames per second)
perf::PerfSnapshot.refresh_rate                                  # a rate (Hz)
perf::ProcessSample.cpu                                          # a percent of one core's time
perf::ProcessSample.gpu                                          # a percent of time
shader::ShaderView::set_size(scale)                              # pixels per point (a display scale factor)
